Any product designed with the electrical spacing (clearance and creepage) for the
indicated voltages will be a compatible device in the system for a given polarity and
system earthing configuration

Special considerations have to be taken into account for cross-compatibility.
Specifically, the full voltage to ground has to be considered in the design for spacing
clearance and impulse voltages etc. For example, devices only designed for bipolar
350/700V might not be usable for unipolar 700V if not designed with sufficient
(larger) clearances towards earth. The (x) label indicates additional caution should
be taken to properly design products such that they can be used over a wider range
